title: [GMCP 203.014.02] Production path: Official Tasks extension and durable long-running work
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-014-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: The official Tasks extension is implemented on both client and server for get, update, cancel, notifications, state transitions, expiry, retries, ownership and server-directed execution. Durable tasks survive process restart exactly once, compose with MRTR and progress, enforce terminal-state invariants, and reject stale, cross-user, forged or replayed task handles. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
